evidence: frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/accounting/pages/PaymentMatchingPage.tsx:61-73 — confirmMutation (confirmMatch) and rejectMutation (rejectMatch) are declared with only an onSuccess (invalidateQueries); neither has an onError callback and neither mutation's isError/error is ever rendered anywhere in the file. Only uploadMutation surfaces failure (uploadMutation.isError -> 'Upload failed' at L112-114).

The confirm/reject buttons (L327-341) wire disabled={confirming}/{rejecting} pending state + 'Processing...'/'Rejecting...' labels, but on a failed confirmMatch/rejectMatch (network error, 409 already-matched, 422 validation, auth expiry) the button simply re-enables with NO toast/alert/inline error — the operator gets zero feedback that confirming or rejecting a bank-statement payment match failed, and may assume it succeeded. Contrast ContentModerationPage.tsx:139-146 in the same app which correctly does assignCase.mutate(id, { onError: show localized alert/toast }).

Impact: MEDIUM. Silent failure on a financial reconciliation action (payment match confirm/reject) — user-facing, misleading, and on money-handling data. Fix (cloud-landable, ppt-web frontend): add onError to both mutations surfacing a localized error toast/inline message, mirroring uploadMutation.isError and the ContentModerationPage pattern. Confidence MEDIUM (static; failure path not runtime-reproduced).

The documents preview surface renders user-facing strings as HARDCODED SLOVAK literals (not routed through react-i18next t()), so cs/de/en locale users see untranslated Slovak: DocumentPreviewModal.tsx:56 'Načítavanie náhľadu…', :64 'Náhľad nie je dostupný.'; PdfPreview.tsx:130 'Nahled dokumentu nie je dostupny.', :150 'Nahled nie je dostupny pre tento typ suboru.', :269 'Chyba pri nacitani PDF: {docError}'; DocumentDetail.tsx:132 'Tento dokument nie je prístupný pre váš účet.' (permission-message).

This is a mixed-language i18n leak, not accepted English-default copy: the app ships sk/cs/de/en bundles and uses t() elsewhere, so a German or English manager opening a document gets Slovak error/loading/permission text. Some PdfPreview strings are even de-diacriticized Slovak ('Nahled','nacitani'), suggesting ad-hoc placeholder copy that never went through i18n.

Impact: LOW (i18n gap on user-facing document preview/permission states). Net-new: no prior i18n finding covers these files (the only backlog row touching DocumentDetail.tsx is a done test-gap sweep, different vector). Fix (cloud-landable): wrap all six strings in t('documents.preview.*' / 'documents.detail.*') keys and add to the sk/cs/de/en bundles.
